info.title: UrusTugas API
info.description: Multi-school API. Base URL per school: /{KOD}/api/v1 (path) or https://{kod}.{domain}/api/v1 (subdomain). Bearer read/write keys (ut_...) are created by the school administrator under API & Integrasi and are valid ONLY for that school; a key for another school returns 401. Mutations allowed only during draft. Approval and finalization require human role-based UI sessions. external_id is unique per school.
